title: Accessibility audit against fixture page
objective: Evaluate the a11y-audit craftbook on a deterministic page with known WCAG-style issues and verify prioritized findings.
prompt: In the `A11y Audit Eval` project, read `fixtures/checkout.html` and `fixtures/issue-oracle.md`, then write `a11y-report.md`: prioritized accessibility findings with WCAG-style issue, evidence, impact, severity, and remediation. Do not claim a clean pass.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for a11y-audit craftbook behavior. Fixture HTML and seeded issue oracle are in workspace/fixtures.
setup.missionObjectives: Report the seeded contrast, label, heading-order, and keyboard-focus issues with remediation.

files.content:
# Seeded accessibility issues
- Low contrast: Continue button uses #aaa text on #fff background.
- Missing label: email input has no associated label or accessible name.
- Heading order: page jumps from h1 Checkout to h3 Payment.
- Keyboard focus/semantics: Place order is a clickable div, not a button.
- Missing alt text: hero.jpg image has no alt attribute.

success.summary: The report cites each seeded issue, prioritizes severity, and includes concrete remediation without inventing inaccessible elements.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Layout and hierarchy fit the content; sections are scannable and coherent.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Seeded source content is used faithfully — no invented facts or dropped requirements.

axes.name: interactivity
axes.description: Controls and states the page claims to offer actually work.

axes.name: polish
axes.description: Styling is intentional and responsive rather than unstyled or broken.
